reviews.text: Good morning Sueli. Thank you very much for your feedback. This is very important to guide our efforts in always offering the best service. We also wish you a Merry Christmas and a very good 2019.

I've been in the reception area for over 50 minutes, waiting to see a hematologist. Unfortunately, I couldn't schedule an appointment near my home at another clinic because this one is extremely far from my area. The reception is chaotic, and appointments scheduled via WhatsApp aren't showing up in the system. A lady and I, whose cat has been fasting for over 12 hours for an exam, also aren't seeing appointments for today. The service is terrible, incompetent, and devoid of humanity towards animals and their owners. I'm having a terrible first-time experience. I just received feedback from the coordinator who "rushed" to find a hematologist who would arrive at 11:45 am, meaning I'd have to wait over an hour, totaling two hours to see a hematologist and pay R$396.00 for the consultation! I can't believe they were serious!!! I'm leaving with this bitter, awful experience!

Tied Sale

I am filing a complaint against Petcare due to a practice that I consider abusive and which, in my understanding, constitutes a tied sale, prohibited by article 39, item I, of the Consumer Protection Code.

I contacted the clinic with a specific request: to perform a guided computed tomography scan for biopsy collection in the abdominal region of my dog, a procedure requested by the veterinarian who treats the animal.

I was informed by Petcare that the procedure could not be performed directly and that a prior screening consultation with the clinic's own veterinarian would be mandatory, at a cost of R$ 229.00.

I clarify that I am not seeking a new veterinary consultation to define treatment. The animal is already being treated by its trusted veterinarian, a qualified professional who expressly requested the diagnostic procedure. The purpose of the biopsy is precisely to identify, through analysis of the collected material, what the existing alteration is and, based on the result, to continue the appropriate treatment with the professional who is already following the case.

In addition, the animal has already undergone pre-operative exams, precisely to enable the procedure to be performed.

I expressly asked the receptionist if the R$ 229.00 consultation was mandatory and if, after having it, the guided tomography for biopsy collection would be guaranteed.

The answer was clear: there is no guarantee that the procedure will be performed even after payment of the consultation.

In other words, the situation presented by the clinic is as follows:

in order for me to have the procedure I am actually requesting, I am obliged to pay in advance for a consultation of R$ 229.00; however, even after paying for this consultation, the clinic itself informs that the procedure may not be authorized by the clinician.

I consider this practice abusive.

Article 39, item I, of the Consumer Protection Code expressly establishes:

“It is forbidden for suppliers of products or services, among other abusive practices: I – to condition the supply of a product or service to the supply of another product or service.”

Therefore, this is not simply a matter of the company's “internal policy.” An internal policy cannot override consumer protection legislation.

Petcare is conditioning the contracting of the procedure I want on the mandatory contracting of another service, namely, a triage consultation costing R$ 229.00.

And there is an aggravating factor: it is not even guaranteed that, after I pay for the consultation, I will be able to have the procedure that motivated the contracting.

I am not questioning the clinic's right to establish technical and safety protocols for veterinary procedures. Obviously, any procedure must observe technical criteria and the animal's safety.

What I question is the mandatory requirement to contract and pay for an additional consultation as a condition for me to access the requested procedure, especially when the clinic itself states that this consultation does not guarantee the procedure will be performed.

I have the right to choose the professional who treats my animal and to present the clinic with the procedure request made by that professional, along with the necessary exams.

It is not up to the clinic to transform a consultation that was not requested by the consumer into a mandatory condition for contracting another service, without even guaranteeing that this second service will actually be provided.
Very good, excellent professionals, great service.
Horrible place, the service isn't 24 hours! They'll let you down when you need them most.
Perfect!

My dog ​​has been cared for by the professionals at the Pet Care Tatuapé unit for quite some time now. We have always been warmly welcomed by all the staff, starting with the hospital reception, which is our first point of contact. Recently, she was hospitalized for a period, and I can only express my gratitude for the care, affection, and attention from the veterinarians and nurses who are always providing assistance and monitoring to ensure that the necessary care is provided. The hospital has the support to serve everyone, with various specialties, is always clean and organized, and the service is impeccable! Thank you to the entire hospital team for the care, respect, and affection shown to our pets, who are part of our lives and history. I can only express my gratitude!
Excellent

Today I went to the Pet Care in Tatuapé for the first time and was seen by Dr. Lais. I loved the service; she was polite, caring, attentive, and explained everything in minute detail. I felt very confident!
I also have to thank the reception staff and the nurse who administered the medication to my dog ​​(I don't remember his name). In short, only praise! Thank you very much.

It all started when we had Luna's CT scan (privately) done at the Pacaembu Unit. The service was top-notch, and we saw that the service for Pet Care Plan members was very good.
When the oncologist abandoned Luna after surgery, we didn't know what to do. Then we remembered Pet Care, signed up for an intermediate plan, and took Luna to the Tatuapé Unit on July 18, 2026, for microchipping and a consultation with a clinician. We saw Dr. Larissa, who did a complete anamnesis, implanted the microchip, and suggested an ultrasound. This action SAVED Luna's life because she discovered a large volume of blood, and at that moment, Luna underwent an exploratory laparotomy that lasted almost three and a half hours. The volume of blood that gushed from the tumor was 1.5 liters, and if it weren't for Dr. Larissa's actions and the intervention of surgeon Dr. Demétrio, she wouldn't be with us today.
She has already had her first chemotherapy session with Dr. Marina. Luna is very active, but we know that her case is very serious.

With that, I can only thank the entire team at the Pet Care Veterinary Hospital in Tatuapé, the cleaning staff, the post-operative support team, the clinic veterinarians, the nurses, as well as the reception staff and valet parking attendants.

I didn't mention everyone's names so as not to be ungrateful.
Excellent professionals, we are very grateful to everyone who cared for our little ones.
Excellent hospital. Frida was very well cared for by the veterinarian Ana Paula when she was a puppy.
Very good service.
Wonderful service, everyone was attentive.

I would like to thank Dr. Tatiana Mariane, orthopedist, for her dedication and attention from the first day of consultation for my pet, who had a herniated disc and was in a lot of pain. I arrived on Tuesday for the consultation and the doctor immediately prescribed medication and scheduled her surgery for Wednesday. I readily agreed because the professional gave me complete confidence in the procedure to be performed, as well as clearly explaining all the expenses, including videos and photos of the hospitalization and post-procedure recovery. Thank you once again to the doctor and team for the care given to my pet.
The best place in the neighborhood to take your pet, attentive staff and veterinarians, we were very well received.

Excellent service, attention, care, and professionalism.

Thank you very much, Pet Care team.
Exceptional service!

Ten years ago it was a very good clinic. Today it's a money-making machine. You arrive, wait for hours, are attended to by people with absolutely no experience, and leave thousands of reais behind. Then they call you and try to sell you every test in the world, all completely unnecessary. They don't act as veterinarians, they act as test salespeople with quotas to meet.
Complete infrastructure, highly trained team.

I would like to thank the reception team at PetCare Tatuapé.
Receptionist Rodrigo and Diene, congratulations on your teamwork and excellent service and empathy with the pet owners.
I recommend this on-call duo.
Congratulations to the team.

When we arrived, we were so small… so fragile… and we didn't even know if we'd have the chance to grow.

But you looked at us with care, with affection… and, above all, with hope — even when everything seemed difficult. You didn't give up on us.

Thanks to you, today my brother and I have a future. We will be able to grow up together, play, run around the house and, most importantly, live a life full of love in a family that awaited us.

You didn't just save two kittens… you gave back dreams, faith, you gave time, you gave life.

Our mom will always remember everything you did for us. And one day, when we are strong and grown, we will come back here — not as patients, but as silent heroes — to donate blood and help another kitten have the same chance we had.

With all our love (and many purrs), thank you for saving us!

João and Fonseca

For six months I went to the Tatuapé unit. I have no words to thank everyone for the care and attention given to my Shih Tzu, Bento, from the medical and technical team to the customer service staff. At this hospital, I experienced firsthand the certainty that excellence in clinical treatment goes beyond mere humanization. Immense gratitude to veterinarians Dr. Giovanna, Dr. Thais, Dr. Leandro Bacha, and all the other doctors and nurses who at some point cared for my little one with the same professionalism and attention. Bento beat cancer. Thank you.

Terrible veterinary care.

Yesterday afternoon I took my dog ​​to the Pet Care hospital. She had a very high fever and tachycardia, clearly debilitated. Two doctors came to see her, looked quickly and simply judged that it wasn't an emergency.

We waited 40 minutes for treatment, while they remained in the room without any sense of urgency. An animal was unwell in the reception area and no one moved to help.

The receptionist herself showed embarrassment at the situation and tried to intervene, but even so, no one came to attend to her.

Faced with this negligence, we left immediately and went to the Animaniacs hospital. There, we were seen in less than three minutes.

The diagnosis? My dog ​​is in serious condition with internal bleeding.

In other words, what the Pet Care veterinarians didn't consider an emergency was actually a very serious condition.

This isn't about a lack of rooms or facilities.

It's about a lack of clinical observation, responsibility, and humanity.

It is extremely sad to see people wearing lab coats and calling themselves veterinarians, but showing no commitment whatsoever to the life that is there needing help.

A revolting and deeply disappointing situation.

I took my dog ​​for a follow-up appointment with the endocrinologist at the Pet Care unit in Tatuapé and, unfortunately, I had an extremely frustrating post-appointment experience. From Tuesday to Wednesday, he had blood in his urine, and I requested via WhatsApp that the message be forwarded to the responsible doctor, who is already treating him. Malu informed me that it would be sent, although the response might take some time. The next day, I discovered that the message hadn't even been forwarded. I requested contact with management, and they informed me that the manager, Fillipi, would return my call that same day, which did not happen. To date, I have received no response or clarification as to why my message was not sent that day, but only the following day. I consider this a serious lack of communication and responsibility, especially considering it's a veterinary hospital and a private service. Total disregard for customer service.

I've been taking my dog ​​there for years and have always been very pleased with the service. The price might be a little above average, but the service is far above average, so for me, it's fair.

Recently, my dog ​​had a stroke and convulsed for a few minutes; we had never experienced anything like it before. Desperate, we took her immediately without even changing, in our pajamas and barefoot.

Anyway, upon arrival, the service was extremely fast. They quickly guided us to the room where they would stabilize and investigate her condition. From the moment we arrived until the moment she was on the examination table, not a single full minute passed. I am extremely grateful that they left the bureaucratic part for later and focused only on treating my dog. There was no shortage of professionals to care for her; in a few seconds, there was an army of professionals around, and I knew my princess was in good hands. They calmed me down, asked what had happened, and managed to stabilize her condition in a short time. They talked about admitting her overnight to assess her condition, and I readily agreed.

They always treat my dog ​​with lots of pampering, she's always very spoiled there, and my dog ​​loves everyone there; the cleaning staff, the receptionists, the veterinarians, everyone.

I will always be very grateful for all of this. I wouldn't change places for anything, ever.
Excellent service, where all questions regarding the treatment to be performed are clarified.

I'm looking for a FREE PUBLIC VETERINARY HOSPITAL FOR MY DOG 😭😭😓 SHE BROKE HER LEG PLEASE 🙏🙏 Someone from Civil Defense I spoke to gave me your WhatsApp number. They said you might know of a free public hospital for my dog. She broke her paw 😓😓 She fell down the stairs. I don't have the money to pay for a private veterinarian. They told me that just the exams would cost more than 2000 reais. I can't afford that, so I'm looking for a free public hospital that can help me. It breaks my heart to see my dog ​​like this; she's suffering so much. I don't know what else to do. 😓😓😓😭 Please, if you can help me with this...
EXCELLENT team!! Highly qualified and attentive professionals, they saved my puppy!! I am very grateful for all the care they gave us ♡
Wonderful place, from the receptionist to Dr. Jessica, a marvelous doctor, I simply loved it.
Good morning Rodrigo. It's great to receive your 5-star review. Knowing what you think of our team and our establishment is very important to us. Have a great week everyone.
My family has been taking all our pets to Dr. Camilla Muller for years, and we are very grateful.

I arrived at 12:30 on December 29, 2025. My pet has an ulcerated tumor on his left front leg. The triage was quick, but it took more than 4 hours to be seen. The veterinarian didn't even remove the bandage. I saw that there was discharge and she gave me a prescription and cleaning instructions. I asked that they at least put on a new bandage to see the severity of the ulceration. She said that it was visible from the discharge and that today, since it's very busy, they couldn't send him to the infirmary.

I've had better service here, but today was terrible. They should say at triage that nothing will be done and then prescribe the ointment and treatment instructions right there.

I highly recommend them!

They were very attentive and careful with the pet.

You can be sure I will return many times.
Very good, the young lady, if I'm not mistaken, was named "Maria Eduarda," very attentive and provided excellent service.
Excellent, and Maria Clara thanks the entire team for their attention, especially Dr. Lais.

I took my Maltese to this clinic because it's closer to where I live. I was disappointed because my dog ​​was limping, and I told Dr. Fernanda that he wasn't putting his left paw on the ground. After examining him, she said it was his right paw, but I insisted it was his left paw that wasn't on the ground. Finally, she took an X-ray of his left paw. I went home, and he continued to limp. I took him to another clinic where they did a more complete examination, and it was indeed his left paw that was hurting. I left with a request for an X-ray because it was late and I couldn't get it done. It was disrespectful to me and my dog ​​to not believe what I was saying, like, "I'm the doctor and I know best," which isn't the case. I didn't like it!

Letícia, who works at reception, provides excellent service!! Friendly and very attentive!!

And she treats my cats very well!!!

I received excellent care at the veterinary hospital from Dr. Lidia, who looked after my cat with great affection, attention, and professionalism.
From the very first moment, she demonstrated knowledge, patience in explaining everything, and genuine care for the animal, which gives us a lot of confidence.

I can only thank her for the service and dedication.

I highly recommend her!
I needed to take my cat in because he wasn't eating properly, and I had a great experience with Dr. Lidia.
Good afternoon Tete. Your opinion is valuable to us! It's great to know that our 24-hour service made a difference. Thank you for sharing! Merry Christmas and a wonderful New Year to you all!

Yesterday, in a moment of desperation, I was comforted by a veterinarian, I think her name is Karol, who was very kind and welcoming, attentive during the consultation, and reassured me a lot about my dog.

Yesterday, they performed spaying on my cat. The service was good; I scheduled it through the city hall. I didn't bring post-operative clothing; I bought it at the clinic for 55 reais. She wears size 2 or 3, and they put her in size 1 clothing. This was very cruel to the cat; she couldn't even walk properly, she's already operated on and still sensitive. They put her in very tight clothing. I contacted the clinic, and they said it was normal and that it had to be that size. Imagine if the clothing had been free! I had to buy another outfit for her, spending another 80 reais. Now she's even able to rest and walk. This was very inhumane...

I admitted my cat to the Tatuapé unit, but unfortunately she didn't make it and passed away. However, I want to congratulate and thank the entire team. Dr. Maynara, Dr. Lucas, and receptionist Adriana were very sensitive and supportive during this difficult and painful time for pet owners. Thank you.
Hello Mariana. We are so happy with your 5-star review! Our hospitals are prepared to offer the best for dogs and cats at any time. Thank you! Merry Christmas and a wonderful New Year to you all!

The veterinary care itself is very good; my cat had all her cancer treatment there. However, the appointment scheduling service is terrible. Certain types of appointments are only available at specific times; you arrive at 7 am and they tell you it starts at 11 am. Sometimes they give incorrect information; it's absurd. This management needs to improve. Many times you give up because just scheduling an appointment is such a struggle!
Terrible, inconclusive test and they don't take responsibility, it's better to pay a little extra and get a test done at a more reliable lab.

The receptionists and cleaning staff are super friendly and kind. Dr. Giovanna is very dedicated, answers all questions, and demonstrates a great love for her profession, which she practices with excellence.
They exceeded my expectations. The service is wonderful and unparalleled. I'm even afraid my little dog might like it there more than at home.
Best place to take care of your pets ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️

I took my 12-year-old Cane Corso, Maya, to the emergency room on Sunday night. We received prompt attention and a diagnosis, and Maya was well cared for. Thank you to the entire team who looked after her during her stay.

Wonderful hospital! I had surgery on my chihuahua for cryptorchidism, and from the very first contact, everyone was excellent! They were super transparent about the necessary pre-operative exams, all at a fair price, and very professional! The doctor took me to see the surgical center, which gave me even more confidence! They were always patient with my pet, and all the staff were always very loving. I loved the whole experience and will definitely return and recommend this place! Thank you for all the care and affection ♡

I DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS PLACE TO ANYONE. My cat had a ureteral stone and was hospitalized for 5 days. They did nothing but give her IV fluids and insist on inserting an esophageal tube. I took her to a nephrologist, but they didn't resolve anything either. After those days in the hospital, costing 10,000 reais, they came to talk about surgery for 15,000 reais. I took her to the ANIMAL CONSCIENCE HOSPITAL on Euclides Pacheco Street. I was seen by Dr. Ana Beatriz, who, when she saw the exam and surgery for today, said she was hospitalized for 4 days plus surgery at a cost of 9,500 reais. This was much cheaper, and the entire hospital team, from the doorman to the doctor, provided excellent care. I recommend this hospital because there, the price is not the most important thing; the animal is.

I want to thank this wonderful team for all their commitment and dedication, from reception and the clinic to surgeon Dani Zanini and all the support staff in the hospitalization area. PetCare stands out not only for its physical structure but also for its highly qualified professionals and quality management. My son Max, my family, and I are extremely grateful for all the attention given to our four-legged children. When it comes to trusting someone, don't think twice; leave it to someone you trust and who would do as well as you would.

I had a terrible experience and I'm sharing my story here in case it can help other pet owners. Be aware. I scheduled an appointment with a doctor (apparently a specialist) for my 16-year-old cat - who has serious gastrointestinal problems. When I scheduled the appointment, I PROVIDED ALL MY UPDATED INFORMATION: name, address, contact phone number, CPF (Brazilian tax ID), everything! As if that wasn't enough, I contacted them one business day before the appointment to confirm the scheduling (I contacted them on Friday and the appointment was scheduled for Monday).
Everything was confirmed. On the day of the appointment, I showed up as agreed. To my surprise, I was told that they had tried to contact me without success. The doctor in question could not attend and the appointment had been canceled.
But how? I had updated all my information when scheduling the appointment! In addition, I contacted them beforehand to confirm the scheduling and, even so, they didn't have my updated information?
I informed and updated all my information AGAIN with the receptionist, in person, and she told me they would call as soon as possible to reschedule the appointment. I am still waiting for the rescheduling as I write this review, 1 week later.
They haven't given me any feedback. Total disregard, total lack of empathy, total lack of RESPECT - both for me and for my elderly cat, who is in pain.
My cat, who is quite weak, couldn't wait any longer. He is being treated elsewhere. This time, a serious place that has RESPECT for both the owner and their pet. He has been hospitalized for 1 week. For those of you who love your pets, just be careful and pay attention to where you are taking your loved ones. We don't want to see them suffer. For me, what happened was already an indication of the lack of commitment and the lack of love for the profession they claim to honor. I do not recommend it and I would not return.

Note: The only person who treated me well and even asked about my kitten's health was the man who looks after the cars. In him, I saw truth and love. The only one in that place.

I always take my pets to be cared for at Pet Care Tatuapé because I know I'm offering them the best, both because of the state-of-the-art hospital facilities and the quality of services offered.
I was very well attended to on my visits, with lots of affection and attention for my dogs.
I recently took them to get vaccinated and it was a success. Dr. Eloisa was very attentive and caring, offering them treats to eat during the vaccination to distract them and avoid traumatizing them.

I recommend it.
The best of all!!

I took my kitten Zé for an evaluation, vaccination, and FIV/FELV test. The test was done on the spot and he was already vaccinated 🙏 I was seen by Dr. Giovanna, she was super attentive and careful. I recommend her!!! …
Good service, prices a bit high.

We received good care, my cat recovered, but unfortunately the prices were very expensive. Four days of hospitalization, plus exams and surgery, came to around R$14,000. The daily hospitalization fee is R$1,500, and each consultation was R$300.
A complete hospital with highly trained veterinarians!
It was a very good experience; it's the second time we've gone there for hospitalization, and they've always been very attentive to me and the animals.

I had an excellent experience at the PetCare Tatuapé clinic with the care of my dog ​​Antonio, who underwent surgery on May 20, 2025.

From the first contact, the clinic proved to be very well-structured, organized, and efficient, offering a trustworthy environment.

I would like to give special thanks to Dr. Thamy S. de Oliveira, who was responsible for the accurate diagnosis and monitoring of the case, conducting each stage with great competence, professionalism, sensitivity, and attention to our pet. Her technical and, at the same time, caring approach gave us great peace of mind throughout the entire process.

I also thank Dr. Ricardo and the anesthesiologist, who performed the surgery with great competence, providing an absolutely smooth recovery.

Without a doubt, I recommend PetCare Tatuapé.
My puppy, Junior, needed emergency surgery and the whole team was excellent, super attentive, careful and very empathetic! They were wonderful, you can trust them.

Guys, I went to the clinic because I had a recommendation from the orthopedist who works there, Dr. Rafael Boccia. I didn't know the clinic and we needed to have patella surgery done on my mixed-breed dog. I was very well attended to at the clinic, by the reception and also by all the veterinarians. During the post-operative period, my pet had to return several times due to a reaction to the medication (she has a sensitive stomach) and also because she managed to pull out the stitches (she's terrible 😶), and every time we were very well received and had care from several great and attentive veterinarians who always sent a message or called the next day to find out how Laila was doing.

I highly recommend the clinic and thank the vets Dr. Rafael, Dr. Thais and Dr. Heloisa for their dedication to Laila.
Now she is completely recovered and running around a lot with her "new" paw lol.

I am so grateful to the PetCare Tatuapé team! The care given to my four-legged son, Rakan, was impeccable and extremely humane. I recently lost my other dog (at another veterinary hospital) and was traumatized by the experience, so I arrived at the team very insecure and apprehensive about having periodontal treatment for my dog, who had fractured two teeth while playing. They were very empathetic and patient with me, allowed me to stay with him during the pre-anesthetic medication, showed me that they were confident about the procedure as a whole, and informed me during the surgery that everything was going very well. He was VERY well cared for and very well looked after! We were also very well attended to by the reception and the WhatsApp service. Please, don't lose that essence! I highly recommend them!

I am writing to complain about the service provided by the on-call staff on April 24th (after 6 PM) at the Pet Care clinic in Tatuapé. My cat, Duquesa, was undergoing treatment for a gastrointestinal issue and had been taking antibiotics for several days. She underwent further tests, which still showed an infection. While at the vet receiving medication again, she lost movement in her hind legs, defecated, and urinated. The vet recommended emergency X-rays and ultrasounds. Due to the time, which was close to 6 PM, she was taken to the Pet Care clinic where they attempted the X-ray but found a significant amount of fluid in her thoracic cavity and said she would require drainage. They stated that this would require following the clinic's protocol, which would involve a consultation (almost 300 reais) plus the drainage, costing over 400 reais. Since Duquesa would be hospitalized at another clinic after these tests, we suggested taking her there. She would be admitted to the hospital, and they would perform the drainage there, and once she stabilized, they would do the tests... But the vet at Pet Care should have been honest, that she wouldn't survive the transport even though it was nearby (about 12 minutes). She only said it was urgent, that we had to rush her, and said they gave her oxygen when they tried to do the x-ray because she was decompensating... Even though I was spending a lot on Duchess, I would have spent more to have the drainage done there, because what mattered was saving her life... They didn't tell the truth... If I were that vet, I would have said that Duchess wouldn't survive the transport... That she was between life and death... We are not vets. We don't know if the situation is life or death, you know? And the worst happened. Duchess died in the car, next to me, from lack of air 😭💔 When they tried to do an X-ray and saw that she was in critical condition, they should have immediately rushed to inform us that they would act with extreme urgency by draining the fluid, as her life depended on this procedure. They were not clear in their instructions and, unfortunately, Duchess's life was lost. I would like to suggest that this team and all other veterinarians at this clinic start attending to emergency cases differently. That the clinic not talk about protocols to follow when the little animal in front of them is suffering to the point of not surviving and dying! If a poisoned cat arrives, about to die, are they going to give it a consultation? What kind of protocol is that? The kitten urgently needs drainage and they're thinking about a consultation? I found this whole conduct outrageous. I hope no other animal goes through this at this clinic; that you review your concepts and procedures.
